changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Dialogue Generation' as the paper focuses only on dialogue state tracking, not full dialogue generation. Normalized dataset name to include acronym. Added a more concise output description.
Normalized the various forms of JGA to consistent naming. All metrics are correctly extracted and relevant for evaluating the generated slot values.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this paper. The paper uses traditional automatic metrics and does not employ LLMs for post-generation evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The evaluation is entirely based on automatic metrics for dialogue state tracking.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on dialogue state tracking reformulated as a question-answering task, which qualifies as NLG since the model generates natural language answers to slot-specific questions. The evaluation uses standard DST metrics (JGA, FWT, BWT) but no human or LLM-based evaluation. The extraction was mostly accurate but needed minor normalization and removal of one incorrectly included task.
